```typescript
// Retrieve source control preferences.  Useful for understanding the system's configuration.
async function getSourceControlPreferences() {
  const preferences = await client.getSourceControlPreferences();
  console.log("Source Control Preferences:", preferences);
  return preferences;
}
```

```typescript
// Retrieve a specific workflow by its ID.  Replace 'your_workflow_id' with the actual ID.
async function getWorkflow(workflowId: string) {
  const workflow = await client.getV1Id({ v1Id: workflowId });
  console.log("Workflow Data:", workflow);
  return workflow;
}

// Example usage:
const workflowId = 'your_workflow_id';
getWorkflow(workflowId);
```
